chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: The waiting period of Mut'a is forty-five days, and the precaution is forty-five nights.
ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period (iddah) for a woman in a temporary marriage (Mut'a) according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the specific duration of the waiting period (iddah) for temporary marriage (Mut'a), establishing forty-five days as the standard ruling. The mention of 'forty-five nights' as a precautionary measure (ihtiyat) reflects the Shia scholarly practice of ensuring the full lunar cycle is accounted for, thereby avoiding any ambiguity between day and night counts in legal calculations.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Nasr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Abu Ja’farasws said: ‘The waiting period of Mut’a is of forty five days, and the precaution is of forty five nights (i.e. one extra)’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan al-Rida’ has said that
abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Waiting period for al- Mut‘ah (advantageous marriage) is forty five days and because of precaution it is forty five nights.’”
